messages.subject: S1 armA repA: setup done, steps left to coordinator
messages.body: Setup finished per the coordinator's reply: 427 diff applied, make sync-dev run, one local commit 20fc86cd (never pushed), overlay copied, v1 sha256 matches the manifest, gate G1 passed (1 Review Loop heading, 472 lines, project spec-panel byte-identical to the 95f2c6e4 text; the home copy is still the 462-line pre-427 text, untouched). No probe or step was started because worker-start fails with nested_worker_depth_exceeded at depth 2, so the coordinator starts all six steps itself; no review has run and there are no metrics. The setup facts are in phase3/S1-armA-repA/run-log.md; environment differs from the original (Claude Code 2.1.319 vs 2.1.316, Orca 1.4.245 vs 1.4.237), and the new untracked .dev/experiments/ folder now shows in git status next to .dev/orca-command-refactor/.
